chapters.title: 湖赫尔曼路之夜
chapters.text: 一九六八年十二月二十日，加州贝尼西亚。十七岁的少年和十六岁的女孩第一次约会，把车停在湖赫尔曼路旁的碎石空地。当晚，两人遇害。凶手没有留下名字，警方也找不到线索。八个月后，同样的手法再次出现——这一次，有人活了下来。

chapters.title: 四个现场
chapters.text: 一九六九年七月四日深夜，瓦列霍蓝岩泉公园，一对年轻情侣在车里中枪。女子遇难，十九岁的男子身中数枪，却活了下来，他向警方描述了袭击者。九月底，湖边野餐的一对情侣，女子遇害，男友幸存。十月初，一名出租车司机在旧金山街头遇害。五个人死了，七个受害者，只有两人幸存。

chapters.title: 三封信
chapters.text: 一九六九年八月一日，三封几乎一模一样的信，寄到了瓦列霍和旧金山的三家报社。写信人承认了前两起命案，还说出了只有警方才知道的细节。信末画着一个圆圈加十字的符号，媒体开始这样叫他：十二宫杀手。信里还附着一段密码，拆成三份寄出。他写道：在这段密码里，藏着我的身份。

chapters.title: 一周之内
chapters.text: 警方解不开的密码，一个星期内就破了。解开它的不是侦探，而是加州萨拉伊纳斯的一对普通夫妇——唐纳德和贝蒂·哈登。他们靠词频分析，一点点剥开四百零八个符号。译文里没有地址，没有身份，只有一句让人脊背发凉的话：我期待自己的照片，登上《旧金山纪事报》的头版。

chapters.title: 五十一年的密码
chapters.text: 他留下的另一段密码，只有三百四十个符号，却成了最著名的未解密码之一。一九七一年，他在信里自称杀了十七人。一九七四年，最后一封信写下：我等于三十七，旧金山警局等于零。二〇二〇年十二月，三名来自三个国家的业余密码迷解开了它。五十一年的沉默之后，译文里依然没有名字。

chapters.title: 仍未说出的名字
chapters.text: 五十年里，案件被归档，又被人重新打开。电影上映之后，线索像潮水一样涌来，嫌疑人被一个个排除，新的说法又轮番登场。今天，警方确认的死亡是五起，他声称的数字是三十七。那个圆圈加十字的符号背后，站着的是谁？五十年过去了，这个名字，仍然没有被说出。

shots.prompt: Wide establishing view of a rural California county road at dusk, winter 1968. Dry hills, scattered oak trees, a long gravel pullout beside the asphalt, dark water glinting far in the distance. No people. Start wide and slowly dolly forward toward the empty pullout; end on the edge of the asphalt.
shots.purpose: 建立日期、地点与空旷感；不先展示任何人物或事件

Through the windshield, a young man and a young woman in late-1960s clothes sit close together, seen from behind, soft silhouettes. A single street lamp out of focus in the background. Slow push-in toward the car; do not show anything outside the car.

shots.prompt: A close view of a 1969 office desk under a green banker lamp. A manual typewriter, an envelope, and a page covered with dense hand-drawn symbols — small circles, crosses and angular marks, illegible as letters. A man's hand places the third envelope down and rests on the symbol page. No readable text anywhere. Slow push-in over the page.

shots.prompt: Three folded 1969 newspaper front pages spread across a wide table. The visible pages show only blocks of type and one printed grid of small symbols, nothing legible as words. A hand presses down the corner of the middle page. Warm desk light, paper texture. Slow push-in across the pages from left to right.

shots.prompt: A modern home office at night, 2020. Three people seen from behind sit at a wide desk with three monitors glowing blue-white, the screens showing only abstract grids of letters and symbols, nothing legible. One points at a screen; a mug of coffee, papers, a whiteboard of abstract marks. Warm desk lamp against cool screen light. Slow push-in over the desk.

shots.prompt: An extreme close view of a computer monitor in a dark room. A grid of small hand-drawn symbols slowly resolves into a grid of abstract letter shapes, nothing legible as words. A cursor blinks. The cool glow of the screen reflects on the edge of a person's silhouette at the right. Slow push-in; the grid stays illegible.

shots.prompt: A 1970s police archive room, tall wooden shelves of closed manila folders, one folder in the center slightly open. A beam of daylight from a high window cuts through dust. shots.prompt: The same archive room, present day 2007. A younger hand in a modern sleeve opens the old manila folder on a steel desk; papers slide out, a fresh folder is placed beside it. Soft window light, quiet. Slow push-in over the open folder and papers.
shots.purpose: 案件重新打开；同一卷宗两次打开

shots.prompt: A modern police office at night, 2020s. A uniformed investigator sits at a desk, seen from behind, before two monitors showing an abstract case board of connected dots and grey blocks, nothing legible. A hand types slowly. shots.prompt: A foggy night in a remote Bay Area parking area, present day. A single old street lamp lights a strip of gravel and weeds, dark water glinting far off-frame left. No people. The camera slowly pulls back and up, the lamp shrinking into the fog. Quiet, still, unresolved.

shots.prompt: An extreme close view of dark rough ground. A piece of chalk draws a circle, then a single cross through it — a simple crossed-circle mark. The chalk line stops, a small piece of chalk dust settles. The frame holds on the mark in near-darkness. Slow push-in; end on the mark alone.
